source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Select "Hardware status" > Click tab "Inventory and LEDs" then check the system informatio

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: System data should be readable and correct.

original_test_intent: Verify the BMC WebUI Hardware status > Inventory and LEDs System information is readable, complete and correct for the intended SUT against the authoritative Project inventory/specification.
original_method: Validate the intended Systems collection/member and WebUI mapping; retrieve the full member over trusted protected read-only access; normalize identity, model/manufacturer/SKU, redacted serial/UUID/asset, health/state, power and relevant links/timestamps; compare against Project SPEC; correlate the WebUI display without altering system state.
manual_activity: An owner supplies the System schema, expected field/baseline and redaction rules. Complete protected API collection and normalization are automatable; optional WebUI capture may be automated or operator-reviewed, and the engineer owns the final verdict.
safety_requirements: Use only read operations; do not clear logs or invoke power, boot, BIOS, OS or reset actions.
Do not use `curl -k`, expose credentials or assume `/Systems/system`; discover and validate the exact member for the intended SUT.
Collect the complete resource and relevant links with timestamps; Model and Status alone are insufficient.
Distinguish absent, unsupported, unknown, stale and missing fields; do not turn an empty result into PASS.
Redact sensitive serial/UUID/asset values while retaining a stable target identity and raw-to-normalized trace.
Stop on ambiguous/duplicate member, schema mismatch or incomplete collection rather than guessing or mutating state.
agent_execution_scope: Validate target/member/schema, trusted access, field matrix, expected baseline and redaction.
Collect the complete Systems collection/member and relevant links read-only with timestamps.
Normalize identity, health/state, power and topology/firmware references and classify missing/unknown states.
Compare to Project SPEC and optionally correlate the exact WebUI view.
Archive raw redacted and normalized evidence and return facts without DUT verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve the authoritative System member, required fields, stable-state semantics, Project baseline and redaction.
Approve any API substitution and its uncovered WebUI coverage.
Review the complete matrix and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A System GET is relevant, but the proposed command disables TLS verification, exposes credentials, assumes the member and reduces evidence to Model/Status. It cannot demonstrate complete or correct WebUI System information.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Discover the Systems collection and selected member over trusted protected access, preserve the complete redacted response and normalize every required identity/status/health/power field before optional WebUI correlation.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Hardware status > Inventory and LEDs System path, readable/correct Criteria, no Script/Bundle and 2/0-minute estimates remain preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Perform complete schema-driven read-only System collection, normalization, spec comparison and optional WebUI parity.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The intended Redfish ComputerSystem/BMC WebUI System inventory.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC firmware, WebUI build and Redfish schema.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor Systems schema and Project system inventory/recipe.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds complete protected API evidence, target validation, timestamps, redaction and objective spec comparison while retaining the WebUI checkpoint.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: API evidence is an override/supplement and does not by itself prove WebUI presentation unless parity is approved; two selected fields are partial only.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: System member/schema, field matrix, baseline and redaction.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Valid JSON from the wrong member or stale state can look correct; inventory identifiers are sensitive.

project_override_considerations: Redfish collection may supplement or replace manual WebUI inspection only when the source method, actual method, reason, engineer approval, per-field equivalence and uncovered display/navigation coverage are recorded.
expected_evidence: BMC/SUT/firmware/WebUI identity, validated Systems collection/member/schema and trusted access
Complete raw redacted member/link responses with timestamps and collection completeness
Authoritative Project-spec comparison and optional exact WebUI parity evidence
Proof no write, reset, power, BIOS, OS or log-clear action occurred and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently define read-only System information in the BMC inventory view. DeepSeek incompleteness is a method defect, not a competing Master purpose.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The target class and read-only purpose are clear. Project/vendor inputs can supply the member, fields and expected baseline, so the case is automatable after readiness inputs rather than BLOCKED.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Retains FULLY AUTOMATABLE but replaces unsafe, partial collection with complete target-validated protected evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees with its classification and strengthens preservation of WebUI coverage and empty/stale-field handling.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Replaces generic YES and two fields with objective completeness and Project comparison.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_source_cases: Keeps System, Manager and physical UID purposes separate.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: No invalid draft exists for this exact source identity.

review_improvement: Prevents false confidence from a valid response on the wrong member or only two fields while keeping the inventory test fully read-only and automatable.
independent_technical_reasoning: A ComputerSystem resource can be syntactically valid yet refer to the wrong member, omit optional but Project-required identity fields, or report stale status. `readable and correct` therefore requires explicit member identity, completeness, semantic handling and authoritative comparison; none requires a state change.
